description: Measures the supervisor's cost and turn count inside /flow-pr-review's Step 8c + 8c.i (run every runnable Test Steps item, tick the boxes, inject evidence) on a seeded PR body, with the surrounding review (fetch, fan-out, fixes) bounded away. One scenario: two passing items, one failing item and one SUBJECTIVE item, so a correct run ticks exactly two boxes and injects exactly two evidence blocks. It prices the per-item recipe against a batched runner on identical work; correctness graders gate, cost and turn metrics are informational.
